# Set Up

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({                                                                 # Suppress startup messages for cleaner logs
  library(dplyr)                                                                   # Load dplyr for data manipulation
  library(tidyr)                                                                   # Load tidyr for data reshaping
  library(minfi)                                                                   # Load minfi for DNA methylation array processing
  library(wateRmelon)                                                              # Load wateRmelon for bisulfite conversion metrics
  library(SummarizedExperiment)                                                    # Load SummarizedExperiment for container objects
})                                                                                 # End suppressed library loading block

base_dir <- "../../.."                                                             # Define project base directory relative to script location
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "Framingham")                       # Define Framingham analysis directory
raw_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "DNAm/raw/EPIC")                                # Define directory containing raw EPIC IDAT files
harmony_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET/_HARMONIZATION/data_CN_only")          # Define harmonization data directory
data_dir <- file.path(harmony_dir, "preprocessing/FHS")                            # Define directory for processed Framingham data
```

# Read Data

## Get Phenotype

```{r load_pheno}
pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "phenotype_all.csv"))                     # Read in full phenotype metadata table
```

## Get Idat Data

```{r load_idat}
RGSet <- minfi::read.metharray.exp(                                                # Read raw IDAT files into an RGChannelSet
  base = raw_dir,                                                                  # Specify base directory containing IDATs
  recursive = TRUE,                                                                # Search subdirectories recursively
  verbose = FALSE                                                                  # Suppress verbose read output
)                                                                                  # End IDAT import call


pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%                                                           # Begin phenotype filtering pipeline
  dplyr::filter(.data$idat_label %in% colnames(RGSet))                             # Keep only samples with matching IDATs

RGSet <- RGSet[, pheno_df$idat_label]                                              # Subset RGSet to phenotype-matched samples only
colnames(RGSet) <- pheno_df$sample                                                 # Rename RGSet columns to human-readable sample IDs
```

## Create SummarizedExperiment

```{r create_dnam}
row.names(pheno_df) <- pheno_df$sample                                             # Set row names of phenotype table to sample IDs
dnam_data <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(                           # Create a SummarizedExperiment object
  assays = list(dnam = RGSet),                                                     # Store raw methylation data as an assay
  rowData = NULL,                                                                  # Do not include probe-level metadata
  colData = pheno_df                                                               # Attach phenotype data as column metadata
)                                                                                  # End SummarizedExperiment construction
```

# Add Annotation

## Get Bisulfite Scores

```{r pred_bisulfite}
dnam_data$Bisulfite <- wateRmelon::bscon(                                          # Calculate bisulfite conversion efficiency
  SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam                                     # Use raw methylation assay as input
)                                                                                  # Store bisulfite conversion metric per sample
```

## Get Gender Prediction

```{r pred_gender}
assay_genome <- minfi::mapToGenome(                                                # Map probes to the genome
  SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam                                     # Use raw methylation data
)                                                                                  # End genome mapping

assay_sex <- minfi::getSex(assay_genome)                                           # Predict biological sex from methylation patterns

dnam_data$Sex_predicted <- ifelse(                                                 # Create standardized predicted sex variable
  assay_sex$predictedSex %in% c("M", "Male", "MALE"),                              # Treat all male labels equivalently
  "MALE",                                                                          # Assign MALE if prediction is male
  "FEMALE"                                                                         # Otherwise assign FEMALE
)                                                                                  # End sex prediction standardization

dnam_data$Sex_match <- ifelse(                                                     # Compare reported vs predicted sex
  (!is.na(dnam_data$Sex)) &                                                        # Require non-missing reported sex
    (dnam_data$Sex == dnam_data$Sex_predicted),                                    # Check if reported equals predicted
  "Yes",                                                                           # Mark match as Yes
  "No"                                                                             # Mark mismatch as No
)                                                                                  # End sex concordance check

print(table(dnam_data$Sex_match))                                                  # Display counts of sex matches vs mismatches
```

# Filter Samples

## Identify Samples to Filter

```{r find_filter}

pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                          # Extract updated phenotype data
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                              # Pull column metadata from SummarizedExperiment
  as.data.frame() %>%                                                              # Convert to standard data frame
  dplyr::mutate(                                                                   # Add QC pass/fail flag
    Pass_Filter = .data$Bisulfite >= 85 &                                          # Require bisulfite conversion ≥ 85%
      .data$Sex_match == "Yes"                                                     # Require sex concordance
  )                                                                                # End QC flag definition

dnam_data$Pass_Filter <- pheno_df$Pass_Filter                                      # Store QC flag back into SummarizedExperiment
print(table(pheno_df$Pass_Filter))                                                 # Display number of samples passing vs failing QC
```

## Save Full Unfiltered Phenotype

```{r save_pheno}
pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                          # Re-extract phenotype metadata
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                              # Pull column metadata again
  as.data.frame()                                                                  # Convert to data frame

write.csv(                                                                         # Write phenotype table with QC parameters
  pheno_df,                                                                        # Data frame to write
  file = file.path(data_dir, "phenotypes_filter_params.csv"),                      # Output file path
  row.names = TRUE                                                                 # Preserve sample IDs as row names
)                                                                                  # End CSV export
```

## Filter Data

```{r filter}
dnam_data <- dnam_data[, dnam_data$Pass_Filter]                                    # Subset to samples passing QC only
```

# Save

## Save Full

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file = file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_data.RDS"))                    # Save filtered DNAm object as RDS

pheno_df <- dnam_data %>%                                                          # Extract final filtered phenotype data
  SummarizedExperiment::colData() %>%                                              # Pull column metadata
  as.data.frame()                                                                  # Convert to data frame

write.csv(                                                                         # Write filtered phenotype table
  pheno_df,                                                                        # Data frame to write
  file = file.path(data_dir, "phenotype_filtered.csv"),                            # Output file path
  row.names = TRUE                                                                 # Preserve sample IDs
)                                                                                  # End CSV export
```
